name: SOURCE_ACCESS_MECHANISM
findings: Registry search (IFA id=25, interim id=6) is ASP.NET WebForms FORM_POST requiring __VIEWSTATE / __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR / __EVENTVALIDATION.
Only cookie set is IdiomaCNMV_ (serialized .NET language object); no ASP.NET_SessionId observed on the registry GET.
URL rewriting 302-redirects *.aspx to extensionless; a POST to the .aspx URL is followed as GET, dropping the body.
IPP XBRL tool (/ipps) is a separate ASP.NET AJAX app using jQuery $.ajax and ScriptResource.axd.
Taxonomy ZIP and raw artefact webservice are stateless DIRECT_URL (no cookies, no redirect, no session).
CRITICAL: bare WebForms postback to id=25/id=6 re-renders the search page with 0 result rows (verified with HttpClient and curl); response byte-identical across different denominations.
limitations: The registry postback semantics were not fully reverse-engineered; exact per-filing retrieval not yet demonstrated. Hypotheses to test: session/__EVENTTARGET nuance, JS/AJAX wrapper, separate results endpoint, additional required fields.
